crossRefs.note: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set…
When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from…
because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service…
whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

people.name: Achaicus
people.line: A Corinthian Christian who visited Paul.

people.name: Fortunatus
people.line: Corinthian Christian; visited Paul in Ephesus.

people.name: Stephanas
people.line: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.

translations.web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
translations.bsb: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
translations.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
translations.asv: And I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they supplied.
